items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Er muss binnen zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Polizei Berlin (Muster) – Bußgeldstelle eingelegt werden.
items.computation: The letter was formally served (Zustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO) and the delivery slip shows 'zugestellt am 11.12.2025' (Thursday). Formal service has no deemed-delivery fiction, so the period runs from the actual service date. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of service (11.12.) is not counted; the two-week period (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB) would end Thu 25.12.2025, but that is a public holiday (Erster Weihnachtstag) in Berlin, and 26.12. is also a holiday (Zweiter Weihnachtstag) and 27.-28.12. fall on the weekend; the deadline therefore shifts to the next business day, Mon 29.12.2025 (§ 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG analog / § 43 StPO).

items.title: Pay the total fine amount
items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, fällig; geben Sie bei der Überweisung bitte das Aktenzeichen an.
items.computation: The Bescheid becomes rechtskräftig (final) if no Einspruch is filed within the two-week objection period, i.e. at the end of Mon 29.12.2025 (see the objection item). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day it becomes final is not counted, so the two-week payment period starts Tue 30.12.2025 and, per § 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB, ends Mon 12.01.2026, which is a normal business day, so no shift is needed. This date assumes no Einspruch is lodged; filing an Einspruch would stop this payment obligation and restart the procedure.

warnings: The letterhead itself labels the sender '(fiktive Musterbehörde)' — a fictitious specimen authority — so this appears to be a template/example document rather than a genuine notice from a real German police authority; do not pay or respond as if it were real without verifying its authenticity through official channels.

The payment due date (2026-01-12) assumes no Einspruch is filed within the two-week objection period; filing an Einspruch would prevent the fine from becoming final and this payment deadline would not apply.

The IBAN printed (DE07 1005 0000 0000 9900 07) is a validly formatted German IBAN, but a valid format does not prove it belongs to the real Bußgeldstelle — confirm payee details independently before transferring money, especially since the sender itself is marked as fictitious.
